trials.title: A Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy of KER-012 in Combination With Background Therapy in Adult Participants With Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) (TROPOS Study).
trials.why: The study was voluntarily terminated early, following a safety review and observation of pericardial effusions.
interventions: Placebo for 24 Weeks followed by Dose B KER-012 for 72 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in PVR (Pulmonary Vascular Resistance)

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company

signals.text: Terminated, reason: The study was voluntarily terminated early, following a safety review and observation of pericardial effusions. [safety]
signals.read: Safety stop. Read-through to the whole program and to competitors on the same mechanism.

trials.commentary: Ph 2, randomized, double-blind. Enrolled 113. Started Oct 2023, primary completion Mar 2025. Stopped: The study was voluntarily terminated early, following a safety review and observation of pericardial effusions. Results posted on CT.gov Jul 2026. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.
